text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Aah... that frilly skirt on display in the show window is so cute...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Still... maybe it doesn't suit me after all...)

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Fufu, would you like to try it on if you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, and after all that effort they took to recommend it to me... What a gutless wimp I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*.
I'm going home to do some muscle training...
